trials.name: 抱臂轻哼
trials.blue_background_requirement_excerpt: BACKGROUND THROUGHOUT [Shot 1], 00:00.000–00:10.000: a perfectly flat, fully saturated digital RGB (0,0,255), #0000FF chroma-key blue matte occupies EVERY background pixel in EVERY frame. Preserve this blue behind the figure AND inside all visible negative spaces between hair locks, arms, body, props and skirt. These empty gaps remain blue when they open or close. The first frame, all action frames and the final frame have exactly the same blue. Never replace it with white, off-white, gray, black, green, transparency, a checkerboard, a floor or a studio backdrop. No fade, background transition, gradient, cast shadow or background texture. The blue is a digital compositing layer; it does not illuminate the subject.
trials.historical_result: Frame0 blue; subsequent239/240 fail blue border and recorded near-white background. No acceptable sustained-blue source was obtained.
trials.key_not_executed_reason: Rejected at source background gate before conversion. No fallback keying of near-white background as if blue.
